name: West Virginia
agency: West Virginia Division of Natural Resources

rule.textEn: Anyone born on or after Dec. 31, 1986 needs a boating safety education certificate to operate any motorboat or PWC.
rule.textEs: Quien nació el 31 de diciembre de 1986 o después necesita un certificado de educación en seguridad náutica para manejar cualquier lancha o moto acuática.

exemptions: Visitors from another state for 60 days or less, aged 15+, with a NASBLA-standard home-state certificate.
Visitors from another country for 90 days or less.
A boat or PWC bought within the last 45 days, if the owner has no prior boating-law charge.

card.nameEn: Boater education card (certificate of boating safety education)
card.feeNote: Approved online courses carry a vendor fee; equivalency-exam study materials are free from the DNR on request.

nonResident: Out-of-state visitors 15+ with a NASBLA-standard home-state card are exempt for up to 60 days; foreign visitors for up to 90 days.
penalty: Lack of a card can only be cited as a secondary offense, after a stop for another violation; the fine amount is not stated.

sources.publisher: West Virginia Division of Natural Resources
sources.quote: Anyone born on or after Dec. 31, 1986 must successfully complete a Boating Safety Education Course before operating a motorboat or personal watercraft upon the waters of this state (20-7-12b).

sources.publisher: West Virginia Legislature, W. Va. Code §20-7-12b
sources.quote: no person born on or after December 31, 1986, may operate a motorboat or personal watercraft on any waters of this state without first having obtained a certificate of boating safety education from this or any other state

sources.publisher: West Virginia Legislature, W. Va. Code §20-7-12b
sources.quote: A person who is a nonresident of this state and who is visiting the state for sixty days or less in a motorboat or personal watercraft from another state if that person: (A) Is fifteen years of age or older;

sources.publisher: West Virginia Legislature, W. Va. Code §20-7-12b
sources.quote: A person who is visiting the state for ninety days or less in a motorboat or personal watercraft from a country other than the United States;

sources.publisher: West Virginia Legislature, W. Va. Code §20-7-12b
sources.quote: A person who is operating a motorboat or personal watercraft which was purchased by the person within the previous forty-five-day period

sources.publisher: West Virginia Legislature, W. Va. Code §20-7-12b
sources.quote: The provisions of subsection (a) of this section may only be enforced as a secondary action

sources.publisher: West Virginia Division of Natural Resources
sources.quote: For those unable to attend traditional courses, approved online courses are available with a vendor-associated fee.

sources.publisher: West Virginia Division of Natural Resources
sources.quote: mail it along with a $10 check or money order to one of the addresses listed on the application.
